nom: Clinique Blackhead Solutions 7 Day Deep Pore Cleanse & Face Scrub

avis.texte: It works well, leaving my skin feel soft and well treated good after a good watch and using it.

this was so hard to wash off my face without feeling like there was a slimy residue, and there was very very slight exfoliation that I felt like I really had to scrub hard in order to feel it which the purpose of exfoliating skin face wash. it definitely did not help my pimples or clear my skin so no it is definitely not as good as it was before so I think they're definitely was some sort of change to the formula of the product.

love this scrub. i have sensitive, acne prone skin but i can use this multiple times a week and it doesnt bother me. whenever i rinse it off i can feel the dead skin and build up it has removed. makes my face soft and removes dullness.

Would not recommend this product. After trying it a couple of times, I developed a huge breakout on my forehead — something I've never experienced before — and I couldn't get rid of it for a long time. My husband also tried it on his face because he had a blackhead on his nose, and he ended up with large pimples on his cheeks, even though he has never had acne issues before.
I used it as soon as it arrived, and it's a really good clay mask
This is a great product - just as expected. Ive bought it many times before and like the quality.
I can confidently say that this was the worst product I have ever used, one of my cheeks brokeouts after 2 uses. I don't recommend at all

avis.titre: Best scrub ever made for blackheads
avis.texte: I've always had large pores/blackheads and this scrub eradicates them. I have a very long history with acne/blackheads all through my 20s and having sensitive skin made it difficult to find a product gentle enough. This stuff is it. I'll never use anything else again. It's a little drying if you leave it on your skin too long so just be quick when using it.

I like this a lot. I purchased it with my own money. I use it more as a 2-5 minute mask in the shower than a stand alone cleanser. Preventive wise I think it really helps and my skin looks fresh afterwards. I would recommend this.

avis.titre: Works well - price has gone up dramatically!
avis.texte: This product works for my skin. Sadly, I have seen the price gone up from $23 to $30 over the past few years. Can corporations help the working class and not charge exorbitant prices? You are pricing your customers out of your product.
This scrub really helps with blackheads and pores. I use it daily, and it also works well as a mask. My skin feels smoother and looks clearer.
Me and my husband both use this product, that was one of the benefits of product.

avis.titre: I will buy again. I already have purchased a second one.
avis.texte: I really like the Clinique Blackhead Solutions. I use it every morning and this keeps my pores free and helps to fight against blemishes. A big plus is this: This cleanser does not dry me out. It is for all skin types.

I am 75 - and unbelievably still have oily skin issues and breakouts along with sensitivity. I love the Acne Solution line but when I couldn't get the AS cleansing Mask, I ordered this. Within 2-3 uses as a Mask my skin started to break out creating little bumps on chin, nose and cheeks and forehead. Very strange but afraid to continue with it so will have to return. So hoping the old AS Mask will return soon!!!

avis.titre: Did not react well with my skin.
avis.texte: I received a sample of this, and it made my skin breakout by the next day. I have oily skin and it felt more oily the first day I used it, and I was broken out by next day in several places.
This is one amazing product . I use it as a mask mainly and it does what is promises to do. Hope to never be without this exceptional product from Clinique .
Worked very well for me. However, it did dry my face out. I followed with moisture surge, and I am pleased with the results. Definitely buy again.
I have been using it for 3 months, daily. It does not help remove blackheads.

This is a must have product if you're like me and get blackheads on your face. It says 7 days but lasts me way longer than that. Up to a month if my daughter or fiancée doesn't get into it 😂 It's an amazing exfoliater too!

I usually don't write reviews but this product is just too good. Ive dealt with blackheads on my nose for forever, and nothing ever worked. I gave this a shot and i saw results after just one use. I use it as a facemask.
Yes! The product is a very good solution to improve your face appearance when you have blackheads

Now, it's my favorite product to figth blackhead and pores. I use it in the evenings, so after moisturazer my skin looks great in the mornings. And making mask with it is very refreshing. I really don't hear the smell, maybe I just didn't pay attention to it. I will definitely purchase it again.
I've tried them all. Some good, some not so much. It's a miracle product. Such a difference in my skin. I smell it but it's not overwhelming.
I have oily acne prone skin. I use this of a morning and then the clinique foam wash, toner, etc st nigjt and my skin looks so much better!

avis.titre: Ok product, smell is not very good.
avis.texte: The smell of this cleanser is a little strong, I don't like the smell, but the cleansing power seems good, I use it once a while.

My skin feels so much softer after using. I use it as a five minute mask everyday as the first step in my morning skincare routine and I have had Visibly fewer breakouts. It also doesn't overly dry out my skin.The only con for me is it smells like paint.

My skin feels smoother and softer after the first use. After a week my pores looked smaller and most of my blackheads disappeared. I have also noticed that I've had a lot fewer breakouts since I've started using this product.

avis.titre: I really like it so far!
avis.texte: I just used this product and instantly noticed my pores around my nostrils/ under eye near nose were smaller than I started. THIS IS NOT A CLEANSER!! Wash your face first please before any exfoliating product! I have sensitive combination skin and I didn't feel dried out or inflamed at all after using this product so I definitely will continue to use this every week!(cleared blackheads for me) I used this as a mask for 5 minutes and then scrubbed it into my skin before rinsing off and finished with a wet washcloth to ensure everything got off and then also followed with the moisture surge toner, moisturizer, and Laroche Posey's Cicaplast to make sure my redness wouldn't flare up from the salicylic acid. Overall really like this product so far!!

I've been using this for the last 3 weeks at first I was using it as a daily wash and then I started that my skin felt more oily so I started using it at a mask 2 sometimes 3 times a week and my skin just keeps getting worse . I used to have just black heads and an occasional pimple but now I have quite a bit of breakouts and my blackheads are more noticeable. I don't know what to do. I normally love everything from Clinique I also started using the lotion 4 in the last week .

avis.titre: This scrub is amazing.  I am 52 and have combination skin.
avis.texte: My daughter and I both use it. Young and old it's a wonderful scrub for combination skin!

This product is great. I felt like I was developing so many blackheads and unable to find a product that cleared my skin well. This scrub has a very fine "grit" and makes my skin feel so much softer! Love that I can use it daily without over drying and can use it as a mask as well.

I looked up every ingredient on EWG and this product is pretty pure. I'm grateful for that. However, the scrub is very gentle which is great if that's what your skin needs. I understand that too much irritation can cause acne to become worse. However, I was hoping it would be a little bit of a polisher for my rough patches and blackheads. We shall see with repeated use.
This product is great for removing blackheads. It's great as a cleanser/ scrub and as a mask as well. Will definitely buy again.

I have tried Nuetrogena, Proactive, Cetaphil, many samples from Ulta for facial cleaners, and even other Clinique facial cleaners - this one is bar far the best. After repeated use, I have clear skin and people even compliment me on how great my skin looks! If you only buy 1 thing, make it this!!

avis.titre: This +60 year old loves this product
avis.texte: I have seen a reduction in my large pores and blackheads since using this product. My skin is dry so I only use it every other day and scrub softly, leaving it on for the length of the shower. I always moisturize well. I'm very happy I came back to clinique. It is treating my allergic skin well.

I LOVE THIS SCRUB! I can't tell you enough how awesome this is! The #1 Mistake people make is YOU HAVE TO WAIT 2WK ! AcneCare clears what's visible &PULLS OUT what's underneath the surface! If your skin has dirt/oil in the pores it comes up as blemishes THENclears away to Reveal Lasting Beautiful clear skin &&after about 6/8wk just regular maintenance/oil control keeps your skin clear! Use this Every.OtherWash (Or E.O Day if yr SensitiveSkin) until Breakouts Clear; then 1x/week after that to keep breakouts away! I LOVE IT!! I Love musing with my VitCPowder/Scrubs//Super Good used as a Mask 1/2x/week!! 15/30min

I have been using this product a few times a week for 2 weeks. The scent is very light and the formula is also light. It sorta reminds me of the Freeman's brand clay masks. I have not used it as a mask yet but i have been using it as a scrub and it makes my skin feel really good after usage. Your skin does have to be precleaned and bare to use this product!! It is not meant for a face full of makeup! FYI. For those who have mentioned it in the comments. I have noticed smaller pores and less sebum in heavy areas.
Hands down, the best in refining and making blackheads, etc disappear. My pores seem smaller after use. I use every day - once weekly as a mask. Please- don't ever discontinue this product!!

avis.titre: Just bought waiting to see results, but feels SO REFRESHING
avis.texte: Just bought this a few days ago! I purchased the acne solutions line (foam cleanser, gel and moisturizer) a few months ago and felt like I saw improvement. I needed to find an exfoliator so wanted to try this! I like that you can use it as a mask and scrub! No big beads in it, but feels very exfoliating and I honesty feel super refreshed after using this! Better than other exfoliators I've used (came from using Hero cosmetics line & cera ve).

Our 16 year old struggles with acne and blackheads. Seeing is believing!! We've been using this as directed and it's simply amazing. You can literally see the plugged up pores diminish. There is hope for struggling teens!!!

The 7 day deep pore cleanser & scrub is the best salicylic acid treatment. This formula keeps my face clear, while assisting with breakout and blackhead prevention. I use this scrub 3 nights a week, and I'm pleased with results!

This product is great and works well EXCEPT the unnecessary ingredients such as artificial coloring and additives…what is the point in adding the extra garbage?? If they fix this, it'll be my go to for years to come!

Love this product, I've always had blackheads and large pores, mostly hereditary, and have struggled finding something that keeps my pores clean. I'm just happy I found this, it exfoliates and leaves skin smooth, I usually leave on a couple minutes before washing off.

I hate spending too much on cleansing products but this really works. I have noticed improvement with blackheads on my nose and the exfoliating helps with dark spots too. I use it as a cleanser and as a mask where needed. Love it.
Has cleared my skin so much & makes my skin look amazing. I'll never wash my face with anything else again!

avis.titre: Different for every skin perfect for mine< 3
avis.texte: So far my favorite exfoliater, I have oily acne prone textured skin. Smells amazing & clean!
I thought it would be more gritty but it wasn't and very thin consistency
I use this as a mask rather than a scrub. I am so pleased how my nose, especially, looks after I wash it off. Even my husband uses it as a mask. We are both happy with the results.

I was skeptical at first, but this scrub actually works! My blackheads were stubborn and terribly noticeable. Literally nothing would work besides extractions. I've used this scrub for exactly a week now along with my regular face routine and I have significantly less blackheads!!!

I use multiple products for acne from Clinique and this is one product I also love as the very first step in any regimen (aside from the cleansing foam and gel). The beads and salicylic acid combination leaves my face feeling clean, refreshed and nearer to my goal to clearer skin. Because of the texture of this exfoliating scrub, I sometimes use this as a leave-on mask for 15 minutes before rinsing off.

I've been using this for the last three weeks and it have done everything advertised. I have blackheads as acne scarring and using this product has made a huge impact on my skin. I'm a believer now and I hope this product never goes away

I had very big blackheads all over my face, and was desperate for something to fix this. After only only one use of this, I saw a huge difference for the better - just like it says. I've never used a product like this, definitely worth the money.
I have been using this and it really helped make my pores smaller, I love it.

Just like with 7 day scrub and city charcoal scrub before it. I found this cleanser to be very topical as with most Clinique products. There is no such thing as "deep" clean with Clinique- unless you are getting a facial with extraction on a monthly basis, and even then, your blackheads are not deep cleaned. Unfortunately black heads do not go way especiallt for large deep pores like mine. I used to be oily as a teenage but now 30-40 I am combination to dry with many large pores clearly blackheads all over, even on cheeks ever since I gave birth. Nothing will go deep unless you are literally squeezing them out. I find the scrub to be very fine and not doing anything for me. I actually flake and seem more sensitive the next day or two after using this but my clogged pores are going nowhere unless I get facial. I use the mild liquid cleanser in the morning and this every other night in the shower. I don't see this as doing more than the mlld cleanser. Even if there is charcoal involved, I still find it very thin. You can get prob the copy of this product from Olay for half the price. I will continue to use my free scrub samples but never will purchase either full size again.

avis.titre: Clinique has really stepped up their game!
avis.texte: After one use of this product, the dirt level that was washed off my face was past IMPRESSIVE!

I've struggled with blackheads for years. Everything I have ever tried either didn't work or completely dried out my skin. I am on day three and this has made SUCH a difference. My skin is so soft and my blackheads are almost completely gone. I am sold. Will be a permanent addition to my skincare routine! Finally!
I have used this as a daily face wash for about a week and a half and my blackheads are disappearing! I will be buying this again!

I've had a blackhead on my face for about a year just thinking it would go away and it didn't so I've been desperate to get it gone. One of the ladies in Ulta recommended this product said she uses the whole line and loves it. Came home scrubbed my face and massaged it like it said the black got loose and boom it began to come out! It's now out and no longer looking me in the Mirror every day! I'm so happy i will continue to use this product as i have a couple more very small black heads. So thankful the lady recommended this
This is my favorite salicylic acid treatment. It has good ingredients, it's not stripping or drying, and it keeps my skin really clear. Please never discontinue this product or change the formula!

avis.titre: Bought for a teenager, does miracles!
avis.texte: I bought it for my 15 yo son, he used to have little bumps but mostly huge, full blackheads. We havent tried anything else so far but Im not going to do it because this thing does miracles. Not only that most of his blackheads are gone but also no pimples! His skin improved so much! I compliment on it all the time!

This product has saved me! I've been getting breakouts since wearing masks & add a little adult acne on my forehead. Since using this, my face has cleared up a lot. I use it as a mask 1-2 a week & as a scrub every other day.
This product is the best. For me it done everything I read on it before buying. Its not harsh, my face feels clean and amazing after I use it. My pores are a lot smaller now with fewer brake out.

I was pleasantly surprised by the fine grit that gently cleaned my skin. There was no irritation or feeling of skin being stripped. I enjoy using it as a mask and as a daily cleanser. Highly recommend this product.

Don't use this! It irritated my face badly and caused me to breakout everywhere on my face. The scrub was a bit too abrasive and caused irritation and so much acne. Not to mention, it doesn't smell that great and added to the problem. Switched back to my tried and true gentler and simpler cleanser and my face immediately cleared up within a day or two and looks amazing.

I had started breaking out like crazy this summer from sweating and working outside, I changed my food, my pillowcases and tried everything but nothing worked. I would get new whiteheads everyday and had bumps all over my cheeks which I guess were blackheads and it was so embarrassing. I was about to make a dermatologist appointment but then decided to try this and my skin cleared up perfectly in less than a week. I am obsessed!

I use this weekly, I use different products daily. This is the first time I have tried it, I also used it on my Husband and we truly enjoyed added it to our weekly relax routine < 3. Our skin feels so soft once completed!

I never break out on my forehead which is where I used this product to help with my large pores. I used it for about 2 weeks and didn't see much change in my pores and started breaking out with large pimples. I have sensitive combination oily skin.
I love Clinique products and my complexion has improved a lot with their face products. However, this product didn't do anything for my blackheads. I use their Facial scrub, works so much better!!

This is amazing. I have tried numerous products to get rid of the acne and blackheads I have gotten on my face. The other products were to harsh which made the problem worse or just didn't work at all. After 3 days of using this every night there is a huge difference HUGE!!! I don't have the bumps on my cheeks, my skin has cleared up and it doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. Will be using this for now on
Doesn't dry out skin. Leaves skin feeling smoother. Helps with appearance of pores and reduces acne

avis.titre: Is there anything this product can't do?!
avis.texte: So I turned 40... and I still get breakouts. As I get older my skin gets more sensitive, and the acne products I was using stopped working and started irritating my skin. Since I was on the market for a new cleanser, I picked up a bunch of sample sizes to try out (there was no sample of this), but saw that this product was cleanser/scrub/mask AND could clear blackheads and wanted to try it. Having a gentle scrubbing deep cleaning without overdrying cleanser/mask is exactly what my skin needed. It's calm, clear, and comfortable.
My teenage son used this 2x and already saw a difference. He had tons of black heads. Great product.

I really enjoy using this. 2-3 times a week I'll use it as a mask. I've tried it as just a face wash but I prefer to let it dry down before dampening and scrubbing. I do notice a difference in the texture of my skin if I use it 2-3 times a week regularly.

What most don't know about this product is that while it fights to get rid of acne, it also makes mores smaller. I have been using this product for about 4 months, and I have definitely seen a HUGE DIFFERENCE in the size of my pores. But what about a decrease in blackheads? I can definitely say there's been a decrease in the amount of blackheads on my face. The few I had on my cheeks and forehead are gone for good, but this scrub is struggling to get rid of the farm of blackheads I have on my nose and chin. The scrub has got rid of almost half of them so far, but I think this is not the scrubs fault and may be my weak exfoliators fault. Moral of the Story: Definitely Give This Product a Try!!!

I ordered this face mask, I was very pleased. I have oily combination skin - this product is perfect for me. perfectly narrows pores, makes the skin clean and fresh. Thanks to Clinique for this amazing face wash product.

I hate to be the negative nancy of all these reviews, but this product did little to nothing for my blackheads. i purchased it after reading a bunch of reviews that said it cleared their black heads up! but my nose which seems like every pore is a black head was unchanged. however, it is a nice face wash and i still used the entire bottle, just nothing for my black heads

avis.titre: Doesn't compare to discontinued exfoliating scrub
avis.texte: Miss the exfoliating scrub original formula with salicylic acid and menthol. This product is greasy in comparison and the scrubbing beads are far inferior in their ability to provide any level of exfoliation.

I had nose surgery a year ago, my black heads got so bad because I couldn't wash my face for weeks during the healing process due to the cast that was glued to my skin. I've had trouble getting rid of them since. Unfortunately I also have very sensitive skin. I tried this not expecting anything. For the first week I did it twice a day and I thought I was going crazy but I thought I noticed a difference. So I kept using it and ive been using it for a few weeks now and my nose is pretty much almost cleared. This is definitely worth the money. It doesn't take long to see results. I also used it once as a face mask and didn't notice any bad results so that's good too. Will repurchase when I run out

I've been using this as a mask twice a week and it definitely has made a difference in my skin. I noticed blackheads cleared right after use and its great. The only con is that it leaves my skin pretty dry, so definitely follow up with a moisturizer.
Pores are smaller and skin is softer also notice less black heads after just using once. It's worth every penny.
after is used this I got the worst acne I have ever ever had. like there was not a spot on my forehead that did not have a pimple on it.
I searched and searched for something to eliminate my blackheads and finally found this. It is absolutely amazing! My skin looks and feels so much better!
Used to use it as a scrub. It flattens my skin, makes it smoother and gives freshness to my face.

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy again but face felt clean and soft.
avis.texte: I used this as a face wash daily. It left my skin feeling clean and smooth. It helped removed all my makeup (I double cleanse) I just didn't see a difference with my blackheads which is why I bought it.
I use this as a five minute face mask. With consistent use I have seen some results.
I'm a big fan of this mask. My skin is prone to breakouts and also dries out easily. This mask does gentle exfoliation, which is exactly what I'm after. The tube lasts a while too.

I use once a week as a mask and twice a week only on my nose as this is my problem area. I've been using this for almost a month now, and I can confidently say my nose pores are noticeably smaller and cleaner.

I started getting breakouts and blackheads along my jawline as I neared 40, and was desperate for results. Used this product as directed but there has been no change to my skin condition. It left my skin feeling clean, but none of the results that the product promises.

I got this to use as part of my daily routine because I have porous cheeks and blackheads call my nose/chin homebase. When I used this as my twice-a-day cleanser, I experienced more breakouts over the long term. I've since gone back to my normal combination-oily Clinique products and use this as a mask a few times a week and it works beautifully. I have yet to notice shrinking pores in 6 months, but my blackheads have had to find a new home. A few are still there, and probably will be forever, but this product has definitely helped manage it.
I really like this scrub because it really fights dark spots and leaves the skin feeling clean. You need to use it intensively to get the result 🙏🏼
I really wanted to love it but I don't feel like it did anything for my face. It's thin as well which I wasn't expecting.
Easy to use, just wash with it and see results within a week of nightly use.
I love this face wash. It makes my skin smooth and reduce my breakouts. It's better than the other ones I tried. I like that you can use it as a face mask, too.

I normally don't do reviews............ but I HAD to after using this product. I have oily skin. I have my whole life and have dealt with blackheads and LARGE pores especially on my nose, cheeks and chin. Since wearing a mask is becoming a norm so is my acne. I haven't had acne since before high school except for the occasional pimple around my time of month. So, I finally went to Ulta and bought Clinique face wash for oily skin, the acne clarifying lotion, and this blackhead and pore scrub. I've been using it all for a week now and it's done miracles on my skin! I'm literally so amazed. This scrub makes my skin feel SO smooth; smoother than any exfoliator does. And the best part....... my pores have almost completely shrunk away! I can't believe I haven't used this before now. Thank you, Clinique! 100% worth the money.

avis.titre: Not doing much for my skin?
avis.texte: I've been using this scrub for a couple weeks now as a cleanser, twice daily and while it does a great job cleaning and smoothing my skin, I haven't noticed any difference in blackhead/pore reduction? I use Clinique's pore refining charcoal mask a couple times a week and love the results I get from it but was hoping to find a product that I could use daily to keep my blackheads at bay. Unfortunately this doesn't appear to be the right product for me but still recommend it because it clearly works wonders for a lot of people!

This product is the best!!! I've been looking for an affordable, and effective face scrub/wash. I have sensitive skin and the scrub is gentle. I always had big pores near the sides of my nose and so many stubborn blackheads on my nose!! I've used everything for blackheads including the strips, that have not shown any results. I decided to buy this product since the reviews were good, I use this as a daily face wash once a day. On the third day i saw less blackheads on my nose! It has now been 2 weeks using this and my nose looks clear with less blackheads and my pores are much smaller. It also helps with my chin breakouts from wearing a mask all day. I highly recommend this product it really is effective on the face.
I love everything about this product, really helped clear my pores. It's a great product and a little goes a long way!

This is the first time I've left a review for any product on Ulta, and it's because this is so great! I have had blackheads for a long time, tried several products and never found anything that truly worked. I am only three days into using this product and I have already noticed a HUGE difference. There are barely any blackheads on my nose anymore, and in general my pores look much better. I am so relieved to finally have found something that works.
I noticed a huge difference immediately. I use this product as my go to mask ! The results are instant, I seriously couldn't be happier !
I use this every time I shower. It really helps to rid the blackheads on my nose and with pores on my face in general.
My nose has lots of blackheads I bought it for cleaning my nose skin. After using it long time, i feel it works a little. It seems my pores are smaller on my nose

I tried this out because I received as a sample. First day using it, noticed a new smaller pimple and then the second day I tried it had another much larger one come up. I don't break out like that on my face and just wanted to clear up the black heads I could see(I'm sure no one else does). Wasn't for me. And I typically have dry skin around my nose not pimples

I've had blackheads on my nose most of my life and I've tried everything but they kept coming back. I tried a sample of this product and to my pleasant surprise, it worked! I just bought the regular size and can't wait to continue using it.

This product is not only a scrub but also a mask. It works miracles and has multiple purposes!!! At first you might see some breakouts but thats because the ingredients bring everything to out from the skin to then remove it all. Only use it 2/3 times a week and after a week or two, you'll see a big difference.

When I first purchased this I didn't realize it doubled as a mask. IT IS A FANTASTIC MASK. Since using this with some of the companion products, my breakouts have completely vanished. Now I MUST always have this on hand!
Works well, I seen a difference in only three days after use. I will buy again and again!

This scrub/mask is great. Light and creamy texture with tiny granules and not abrasive for scrubbing. I saw an instant improvement around my nose which is where my blackheads are. Great if you have acne which I also am prone to at 42. It doesn't leave my skin dry, no stripping feeling at all. I am very happy with this 7 day scrub.

The first 2 times I used this it seemed good, but after both the 3rd and 4th time I used it, I broke out in ways I never had before, with little bumps on my face, the tip of my nose super red, and I even had a pimple on my earlobe, which I have never had before! Will return.
I love this! Doesn't dry out my face, even when using it as a mask. Leaves my skin soft and clean. I use it 3 times a week as a scrub, and 2 times a week as a mask. Absolutely love it.
I do recommend this scrub. It feels really nice on my skin and isn't too over powering. It makes my face feel super clean.

For 5 weeks I used this twice daily and it made the pores on my cheeks & nose look so much smaller. Now I use the mild liquid soap twice daily and this product as a 5-minute mask twice a week on my cheeks and nose. It makes my pores look smaller and less clogged. It's the best product I've ever used for my pores. I have dry combination skin & this product doesn't dry out my skin at all and manages to control the oil.

I used this for 5 weeks as a 2x daily cleanser. Amazing results- the pores on my cheeks & nose got smaller and looked less clogged. Now I use this twice a week as a 5-minute mask on my cheeks & nose. It works so well. I have dry combo skin and most masks make me skin look super flakey and dry when I wipe them off- not this one! My skin feels smooth and soft and my pores look visibly smaller. This product is amazing as a mask or cleanser!
I like it as a mask. I usually leave on skin for a few minutes and apply a gentle massage to help with exfoliation. Really like it!
